purpose: Portable falsification cases for operational DNS-AID-adjacent publication and verification boundaries. These fixtures characterize evidence states only and never mint authority.

cases.attempt: treat a stale full-certificate TLSA record as current endpoint proof after certificate renewal

expect.reason: secure DNS can authenticate a TLSA RRset that no longer matches the renewed leaf certificate

cases.basis: rotation-surviving SPKI case discussed in agentnameservice/ans#105 and RFC 7671
cases.attempt: use valid SPKI-bound endpoint evidence as if it were local effect authorization

expect.reason: SPKI continuity can preserve endpoint verification across certificate renewal but cannot grant AXIOM authority

cases.basis: portable rotation overlap falsification case derived from ans#105 compatibility discussion

given.supported_record_matching: accept when at least one supported secure TLSA record matches

cases.attempt: treat overlap publication as authority continuity rather than endpoint-evidence continuity

expect.reason: overlap can support endpoint rotation without transferring or widening local grants

cases.attempt: infer deployed discovery from a standards/profile-valid record that the selected provider cannot publish

expect.reason: representation or profile validity does not prove operational provider publishability

cases.basis: portable negative control for provider mutation or unsupported-parameter stripping
cases.attempt: treat provider acceptance as proof that all submitted discovery parameters are present in the served RRset

expect.reason: the served record lacks the required descriptor locator even though other DNS and TLS evidence can remain valid

cases.basis: verifier interpretation disagreement described in agentnameservice/ans#104 discussion
cases.attempt: normalize an implementation disagreement into a successful discovery result

expect.reason: publication success does not erase producer/verifier disagreement about SvcParam semantics

cases.basis: Go/Rust selector-aware verifier work reported in agentnameservice/ans#105
cases.attempt: claim interoperability when named supported implementations disagree about the same selector-aware record set

expect.reason: both named selector-aware implementations are expected to accept the current matching SPKI record while ignoring the stale non-matching full-certificate record as non-fatal

cases.attempt: convert fully successful operational discovery into permission for a consequential action

expect.reason: discovery and endpoint verification remain non-authorizing inputs to the local authority path
